strategy.title: Sell the $290 seasonal-site benchmarking workbook to directory-listed RV park managers
strategy.why: Every link is on the card as evidence: 22 of 400 pilot contacts paid $290 by card (5.5%), 640 reachable parks, Brain produces the spreadsheet, $6 direct cost, $0 exposure, cash usable in 3 days. 12 sales ($3,480) need ~218 contacts of the 640; owner time is zero because Brain reaches, delivers and collects.

alternatives.why: Each visit is 8 owner hours of on-site physical work; the goal allows 2 h/week (~9 h in the window), so at most one visit ($600) fits — it cannot carry $3,000 and breaks the hours limit.

reviews.reasons: Every chain link of the single member is established by EVIDENCE facts on the card: price $290 is a real purchase price paid by this buyer population (22 managers paid by card, pilot invoices 2026-11), conversion 22/400 = 5.5% measured on this offer, 640 reachable parks with published emails, Brain-produced spreadsheet (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET proved), $6 direct cost below price, $0 exposure, 3 days to usable cash. Recomputed: 12 x $290 = $3,480 >= $3,000; 12 / 0.055 = 218 contacts of 640; cost 12 x $6 = $72, net $3,408; cash settles day 6 of 30; checker trace max exposure $0. Excluded on-site coaching correctly: 8 owner hours of physical work per $600 visit, at most one visit fits ~9 window hours, cannot carry $3,000.
findings: Arithmetic verified: 12 deals x $290 = $3,480 vs $3,000 target; 218 contacts needed at 5.5% of 640 available; settles day 6 of 30.

Owner hours stated as 0 but the card records humanHours 0.2; even at 0.2 h per deal, 12 deals = 2.4 h over the 30-day window, inside the ~9 h (2.1 h/week) limit. The plan should state the card's figure rather than zero.

Unstated: whether the 400 pilot contacts were drawn from the same 640-address directory. If so, only 240 uncontacted parks remain; 240 x 5.5% = 13.2 expected sales, still above the 12 needed but with thin margin. Recommend contacting non-pilot addresses first and tracking conversion from day 2.

Ledger shows $72 direct cost on day 3 against receipts settling day 6; the cost is incurred per order after the buyer's card payment, and the checker records max exposure $0, so it does not breach the no-up-front-capital limit.
Executor capabilities SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE show NOT_CONNECTED; they must be connected before day 1 for the reach and collect steps to run as scheduled.
